gloss: to be able to wait (usu. negative: can't wait)

definitions.gloss: to be able to wait; (in the negative) to not be able to wait
definitions.explanation: To be capable of waiting until something finally arrives. Used almost exclusively in the negative {待|ま}ちきれない, which expresses impatient excitement — "I can't wait."

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{待|ま}ちきれない。
{子|こ}どもたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{待|ま}ちきれない⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧だ。
examples.english: The children look like they can't wait for summer vacation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{待|ま}ちきれず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧⟦{聞|き}き→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Unable to wait for the results to be announced, I went to ask the teacher directly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発売日|はつばいび}→発売日：10160_hatsubaibi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧あと⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧{待|ま}ちきれない。
examples.english: A whole week left until the new game comes out — I really can't wait.

notes:
The potential form of ⟦{待|ま}ち→待つ：00469_matsu⟧きる (⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ "wait" + 〜きる "do completely"). The affirmative is rare; learners will meet this word as {待|ま}ちきれない or the adverbial {待|ま}ちきれず(⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ...⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{待|ま}ちきれない: can't wait for ...
- {待|ま}ちきれず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do something without waiting any longer
- {待|ま}ちきれない⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧: looking unable to wait

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{楽|たの}しみにする→楽しみにする：26825_tanoshiminisuru⟧: to look forward to — states anticipation calmly, without the sense of straining at the delay
- ⟦{待|ま}ち{遠|どお}しい→待ち遠しい：14726_machidooshii⟧: eagerly awaited — an adjective describing the awaited thing, not the person waiting

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {待|ま}ちきれていませんでした
